skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the silent pauses and cut the intro down to 30 seconds — and get trim...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Trimmer Exe — AI-powered video trimming and export tool.
- Quickly trim, cut, and export video clips by simply describing your edits; no manual software required.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automated setup with instant free token generation for quick onboarding.
- Cloud-based GPU rendering delivers trimmed clips in 20–40 seconds, supporting multiple export formats.
